# refactor .bash_profile and .zshrc installation

Reduce the shell integration to one `source` line per shell. The installer appended two lines — a shared `.profile` and a shell-specific file:

```
source "..."/.bash_profile
source "..."/.profile
```

and both shells loaded the same libraries through two indirections.
